title: About payment
body: I just saw on Instagram how a man used this app, and after watching the preview (inside the app) about all its benefits and how it can transform my life, I was really looking forward to trying it! But guys (the creators of the app), why do you keep repeating this 66, 66, 66? I get it—I definitely need this app for two months, but no more (since I haven’t tried it yet, and maybe after two months, I’ll get used to it and incorporate it into my daily routine). And yet, you offer me only two payment options: a full-year subscription (which, at this point, I don’t see the need for) or a monthly plan that, for two months, costs even more than the full-year option. How does this make me feel? Like you’re trying to trick me into buying a one-year subscription before I’ve even had the chance to try the app. It’s a “choice without a choice.”
